testName: Salesforce REST Composite API Batch Payload & Transaction Rollback
steps:
1. Send POST request to "/services/data/v60.0/composite" with allOrNone=true
2. Sub-request 1: Create Account "Valid Enterprise Corp"
3. Sub-request 2: Create Contact with invalid email format "invalid-email-address"
4. Verify HTTP Response status is 400 Bad Request
5. Verify sub-request 2 returns error code "INVALID_EMAIL_ADDRESS"
6. In Salesforce UI, search for Account "Valid Enterprise Corp"
7. Verify zero records exist, proving atomic transactional rollback across all batch items
